contract.purpose: Make MAGRA the runtime identity across system prompt, CLI, doctor, dashboard labels, and compatibility messaging.
contract.scope: Product constants, default system prompt, CLI help/version text, dashboard brand labels, and Reasonix compatibility aliases.

invariants.invariant-1: The primary runtime self-identifies as MAGRA.
invariants.invariant-2: `reasonix` and `dsnix` remain documented compatibility aliases, not primary identity.
invariants.invariant-3: Brand changes do not break existing Reasonix-compatible command behavior.
